name: Canvas LMS API
tagline: Higher-ed LMS REST API for courses, assignments, grades, and enrollments
description: Canvas LMS exposes a comprehensive REST API used by schools and edtech integrations to manage courses, users, enrollments, assignments, submissions, grades, calendars, and more. Each institution hosts Canvas at its own domain; API paths are relative to that instance. Developers typically authenticate with OAuth2 or an access token and call versioned endpoints under /api/v1.

auth.details: OAuth2 (preferred) or manual access tokens via Authorization: Bearer <token>; tokens are created per Canvas account/instance, not a global self-serve API key portal.

pricing.paid_plans: Canvas is commercial LMS software licensed to institutions; API access is typically included with an institutional Canvas instance, not sold as a standalone public SaaS API plan.

rate_limits: not published as a single global number; throttling is enforced per Canvas instance (often via X-Request-Cost / X-Rate-Limit-Remaining style headers). Check your institution’s Canvas admin docs.
use_cases: list courses for the authenticated user
sync SIS/user roster data into Canvas
